name: concurrent_collective_wow_tp4_tp8_v1
mapping_definition: nearest_root: anchor at first row-major compute endpoint, then ascending squared planar distance, y, x, endpoint ID; no performance search
controls: Within each TP: same complete block, root-gather/sum/broadcast action DAG, seed, compute/memory rates and capacities. Only author placement and the two explicit mapping policies vary.
scope: Separate eight-head block because TP8 requires at least eight whole attention heads; not a workload-preserving change to the original four-head TP2 case. No sweep or calibration.
